# Tamworth Informed

> Tamworth’s digital community hub, coming soon.

Tamworth Informed is a digital community hub for Tamworth, Staffordshire, England. It connects residents, local businesses, tradespeople and employers. The website is coming soon.

The public community is the Facebook group: https://www.facebook.com/groups/560283727406222

- Over 47,000 members
- Over 2 million in reach
- Business opportunities available

## Contact

Questions and involvement messages go through the form on the homepage. Name, email and message are required. Telephone is optional. Email office@tamworthinformed.com directly.

## Canonical

https://tamworth-informed.netlify.app/

## Language

en-GB
